audience: racquet and paddle sports clubs using CourtReserve

useCases.title: Review court schedules and availability
useCases.text: List your courts, inspect availability for a date, and review reservations to see how the club schedule is being used.

useCases.title: Review event registrations and waitlists
useCases.text: Find upcoming clinics or events and compare registered players with the waitlist. Review the results without changing any bookings.

useCases.title: Summarize club revenue and membership
useCases.text: Review a period of payments and refunds by category, then inspect membership reports to understand the club’s current membership activity.
